name: UCI Waveform Database Generator (Version 1)
description: The UCI Waveform Database Generator (Version 1) is a synthetic tabular benchmark for multiclass pattern recognition. Based on the classification model introduced by Breiman et al. in CART (1984), it consists of 5,000 generated signal instances defined across 21 continuous attributes with additive standard normal noise, partitioned among three distinct triangular wave combinations.
